_comment: Annotated copy of mcp_servers.json. Keys that start with '_' are ignored by spark/brain/mcp_config.py.
Every server also needs an entry under connectors.servers in config.yaml (enabled flag and tool lists); servers without one are not loaded.
Values are ${VAR} placeholders only. Put the real values in .env. The claude CLI expands them itself, so secrets never appear on its command line.
A server whose ${VAR} is missing or empty is disabled with a warning. Write ${VAR:-default} to make a variable optional.
stdio: type, command, args, env. http/sse: type, url, headers. A relative command path resolves against the config folder.
On Windows an npx (or other .cmd shim) command is run as 'cmd /c npx ...' automatically.

github._comment: GitHub's hosted MCP server (github/github-mcp-server). Needs only a fine-grained token in SPARK_GITHUB_PAT (README: GitHub in two minutes). Write tools are offered, but config.yaml lets them run only after a spoken yes (side_effecting) or never (destructive); any other tool is denied. GitHub lists Copilot access as a prerequisite (docs/connectors.md §6).

_github_local_example._comment: Shape of the same server run locally (the github-mcp-server exe from github/github-mcp-server releases) when the hosted one can't be used. Rename the key to github (no leading '_') to use it instead. Add --read-only to the args to strip write tools at the server.

_composio_example._comment: Composio dedicated MCP server (Gmail + Google Calendar). URL looks like https://backend.composio.dev/v3/mcp/<server-id>?user_id=<user>. Do not use session / Tool Router URLs: their meta tools defeat the allowlist. Rename the key (no leading '_') and add a connectors.servers entry in config.yaml to use it.

_composio_outlook_example._comment: Separate Composio server for Outlook so it can be switched off on its own. Disabled by default in config.yaml (spec §12). Rename the key (no leading '_') and add a connectors.servers entry in config.yaml to use it.

_filesystem_npx_example._comment: Shape of an npx-based stdio server. Rename the key (no leading '_') and add a connectors.servers entry to use it.
